title: TS-65 Handoff step 1: the computer owner core in conversation/src
description:
Source: the Pi session handoff spike (PR 474: spikes/pi-handoff, docs/PI_HARNESS.md section 'Spike: handoff to a computer owner', GO in steps) and docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md. Decision (user): the goal is a Pi session running in the computer container, using Pi's own tools (read, write, edit, bash from @earendil-works/pi-durable/tools), with the session portable between owners. Security gate before production: the container must not hold the model key or broad storage credentials.

Scenarios first. (1) a seam so TurnAttempt.execute no longer hard-codes computerToolsExtension (optional deps override; production default unchanged); (2) an env option on openOwnerSession (pi-durable NodeExecutionEnv rooted at /workspace); (3) local computer tools: Pi's CodingTools wrapped with our tool names (read_workspace, write_workspace, edit_workspace, run_terminal: the gate denies Pi's native names), each call recorded in the action ledger, replay safe (idempotent tools rerun; run_terminal that was started but not finished reports interrupted and is NOT rerun), the existing gate and grant checks still apply; (4) a takeOverTurn / computer owner function that resumes a parked turn (resumeTurnForAction) and runs the same executor core with the Lambda-only pieces injectable (SQS visibility, acknowledge, turnRuns and turnProbes sends); (5) scenarios: takeover and finish; hand back and the next owner sees the container's results; a crash in the middle of run_terminal does not rerun the command; two owners racing for the fence: one wins, the other stops with OwnershipLost and does nothing; the grant gate still denies a path outside the grant in the computer owner; the Lambda path is unchanged. Mutation checks. No AWS.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as done. Evidence on origin/develop: conversation/src/turn/computer-owner.ts (takeOverTurn, the owner core that resumes a parked turn and runs the shared executor with the Lambda-only pieces injected); features/computer_owner_handoff.feature covers every scenario this ticket listed (takeover and finish, hand back to a Lambda-style owner sees the container's results, a crash mid-command does not rerun it, two owners racing for the fence: one wins, the other changes nothing, grant gate denies a path outside the grant, the edit tool, scrubbed environment, no start outside the workspace); features/computer_owner_lost_claim.feature and features/pi_session_ownership.feature pin the fence. Merged: PR 486 (phase 1), PR 487 (cutover), PR 488 (docs). Live proof: README 'The computer runs Pi on development' and docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md (smoke turn, security check, recovery after a stopped owner, a bug-fix task persisted to a fresh owner).

right_now_summary: The computer owner core now resumes parked turns and runs Pi tools with shared ownership and safety checks.
